headline: NVIDIA Surpasses Q3 Revenue Forecasts on Surging Enterprise AI Demand
text: NVIDIA Corporation delivered robust quarterly results this morning, outpacing consensus Wall Street expectations. Diluted EPS reached record highs as revenue expanded 18% year-over-year.

headline: Antitrust Regulators File Formal Injunction Against Apple Over App Store Policies
text: Federal antitrust authorities initiated formal litigation against Apple Inc., alleging anti-competitive practices and exclusive distribution agreements seeking civil fines of up to $2.2 billion.

headline: Central Bank Unexpectedly Hikes Policy Rate by 50 Basis Points to Curb Inflation
text: In an emergency inter-meeting adjustment, monetary authorities raised the policy interest rate by 50 basis points. Yield curves steepened sharply as commercial banks recalibrated prime lending rates.

headline: JPMorgan Discloses Critical Network Intrusion and Halts Affected Trading Portals
text: JPMorgan Chase filed an 8-K disclosure acknowledging a sophisticated security breach that compromised internal account authentication services. Management retained third-party cybersecurity investigators.

headline: Federal Reserve Holds Benchmark Overnight Borrowing Rates Steady at 5.25%
text: The Federal Open Market Committee concluded its policy meeting by voting unanimously to hold benchmark rates steady, noting balanced employment conditions and progress on disinflation.
